findings.name: total open exposure under 12%
findings.detail: peak open cost $10,500 (8.3% of account), cap $15,271; above the cap at 0 of 416 points in the week

findings.name: no unprotected position over 5% overnight
findings.detail: nothing above the cap at a session boundary
findings.caveat: Market value is approximated from the last traded price of that symbol, and the feed cannot separate strikes, so a position spanning several strikes is marked at one price. Treat flagged nights as candidates to review, not as confirmed breaches. A live stop also satisfies the rule and is invisible here.

findings.name: check the commission below $0.30
findings.detail: $36,103 of premium entered at or below $0.30 across 13 symbols; round-trip friction on that is roughly $1,805-$3,971

findings.name: a day down 7% ends the day
findings.caveat: Realised P&L plus premium written off at expiry. The rule is written against account value, which also moves with open positions, so a day can breach it without showing here.
